b1_1.t: April, nineteen fifty-one. Nevada. The Army's been setting off atom bombs out on the flats, and the folks in Las Vegas watch the flashes from their hotel roofs like it's the Fourth of July.

b1_2.t: Three weeks back my little brother Hollis wrote me. Said he'd been hauling sealed freight at night for a man named Vale. Said he'd seen something he shouldn't have. Then the letters stopped.

b1_3.t: So I put Sally back together, bolted a pair of thirty-cals to her hood, and drove east. Hollis's girl runs a salvage yard out on the dry lake. The Boneyard. That's where I start.

m1_rosa_01.t: You must be Wade. Hollis said you'd come. Said you'd come loud, too.

m1_deacon_01.t: Folks call me Deacon. Where's my brother, Miss Delgado?

m1_rosa_02.t: It's Rosa. And if I knew that, I wouldn't need you. First let's see if that Mercury drives as good as she looks. Run the flags out on the lakebed.

m1_rosa_03.t: Not bad, for a California boy. Now the junkers by the fence. Line them up and let those thirty-cals talk.

m1_rosa_04.t: Sally's got teeth. Good. Because we've got company. Dust on the east road. Three cars, running chrome.

m1_legion_01.t: That's the Merc! Mister Vale wants it scrapped!

m1_rosa_05.t: The Chrome Legion. Vale's boys. Hot rods and war surplus. Don't let them near the yard!

m1_rosa_06.t: Well. Hollis always said you were the mean one.

m1_deacon_03.t: Hollis always did talk too much. Where was he seen last?

m1_rosa_07.t: Tonopah Junction. Hal's truck stop. His rig never came back from there.

b2_1.t: Hal's truck stop sits where the Tonopah road meets Highway Ninety-Five. Last place anybody saw Hollis's rig.

b2_2.t: Rosa patched Sally's armor and scrounged a rocket pod off a Navy surplus lot. Zuni rockets. Meant for airplanes, she said. I told her Sally would fly if she had to.

m2_rosa_01.t: Smoke on the horizon, Deacon. That's Hal's place.

m2_legion_01.t: Torch the pumps! Nobody talks to the Merc!

m2_rosa_02.t: Hal's still inside! Clear them out before the whole place goes up!

m2_hal_01.t: Lord almighty, I thought I was cooked. You Hollis's brother? You got his ugly jaw. He left something with me. His logbook, in the rig out back. The one they burned.

m2_deacon_02.t: Hollis's rig. Burned down to the frame. Logbook's in the glove box, still in one piece.

m2_deacon_03.t: Night runs. Mercury to the old Silver Queen mine. Sealed crates stenciled A. E. C. Every manifest signed by Vale.

m2_rosa_03.t: The Atomic Energy Commission? Deacon, what did Hollis get himself into?

m2_legion_02.t: There he is! Box him in, boys!

m2_rosa_04.t: More of them, coming down Ninety-Five! Finish it and get out of there before the law shows. Around here, the law is worse.

m2_rosa_05.t: Come on home, Deacon. We've got reading to do.

b3_1.t: Nye County Sheriff Boyd Harlan runs this stretch of desert like a toll road. Everybody pays him, and everybody knows who pays him.

b3_2.t: Rosa says he's been asking around about a black Mercury with California plates. I figured I'd save him the trouble of looking. And she gave me a crate of road mines, for company.

m3_harlan_01.t: Black Mercury, California plates. You're a long way from home, boy.

m3_deacon_01.t: I'm looking for my brother, Sheriff.

m3_harlan_02.t: Tell you what. You turn around, drive west, and you won't wind up next to him.

m3_deacon_02.t: So you do know where he is.

m3_rosa_01.t: Those are county cruisers, Deacon! Armored doors and a lot of buckshot. Don't trade paint with them head on.

m3_deputy_01.t: More units coming up behind him, Sheriff!

m3_harlan_04.t: You're only making this worse, son!

m3_harlan_05.t: Vale. Vale's got the Colonel in his pocket. You're a dead man, Calloway.

m3_rosa_02.t: The Colonel. That's Rusk. He runs security at the Proving Grounds. Deacon, this goes a lot higher than a county badge.

m3_rosa_03.t: I know somebody who hates Vale more than we do. Meet him at Gold Creek. Bring your appetite for scripture.

b4_1.t: Gold Creek was a boom town in nineteen-oh-six and a ghost town by nineteen-twenty. Now it's home to Elijah Tate, who some call Preacher, and the Treasury Department calls a person of interest.

b4_2.t: He runs gas, guns and gospel across three counties, and Vale's been choking his supply lines. Today Preacher's convoy rolls to the Boneyard, and I'm riding shotgun. Harlan's fifty-cal rides with me.

m4_preacher_01.t: Brother Calloway. The Lord sends me a black car with guns on it. I've prayed for stranger things.

m4_deacon_01.t: Rosa says you've got a grudge against Vale.

m4_preacher_02.t: Augustus Vale took my stills, my trucks, and my good nephew Amos. I aim to take back what I can. Stay close to the Glory Wagon, and mind the supply truck. It carries everything we'll need.

m4_legion_01.t: It's the Preacher's hearse! Somebody's gonna need it!

m4_preacher_03.t: Heathens on the flank! Brother Calloway, smite accordingly!

m4_preacher_04.t: They're on the supply truck! Get them off of it!

m4_rosa_01.t: I can see your dust from the water tower. Two more miles, boys.

m4_preacher_05.t: And the Lord said, let there be a second wave. I never did care for that verse.

m4_preacher_06.t: Hallelujah. Brother Calloway, you drive like the Devil's own chauffeur, and I mean that as a kindness.

m4_rosa_02.t: Deacon. I just picked up something on the military band. A woman's voice, begging for help on Ninety-Five. English accent.

b5_1.t: Her name is Doctor Miriam Holt. A physicist, on loan from the British to the Proving Grounds.

b5_2.t: Rosa caught her mayday at dawn. A woman running south on Ninety-Five in a station wagon, with half the Chrome Legion on her bumper. Anybody Vale wants that bad, I want first. Rosa rigged Sally with an oil slick. Dirty trick. I like it.

m5_miriam_01.t: Mayday, mayday! Is anyone on this frequency? I'm southbound on Ninety-Five in a green Ford wagon. There are men with guns behind me!

m5_deacon_01.t: Ma'am, this is Deacon. Keep your foot down. I'm coming up the road.

m5_miriam_02.t: Please hurry! They've shot out my back window!

m5_legion_01.t: Stop that wagon! Vale wants the egghead breathing. Mostly.

m5_miriam_03.t: They're hitting the car! I can't hold it much longer!

m5_miriam_04.t: Oh, thank God. Thank you, whoever you are.

m5_deacon_02.t: Follow the highway south, Doctor. There's a safe place out on the dry lake. I'll be right on your tail.

m5_legion_02.t: Roadblock's blown! Run 'em down, run 'em all down!

m5_miriam_05.t: I've been checking shipping manifests at the Proving Grounds. Three plutonium cores went out for testing. Only two came back to the vault.

m5_miriam_06.t: As in the heart of the bomb. Colonel Rusk signed off on every discrepancy. And every missing crate went out on a truck owned by Augustus Vale.

m5_miriam_07.t: Then your brother may be the only witness still alive.

b6_1.t: Vale runs his trucking out of a depot outside the Mercury gate. Radio mast, fuel farm, motor pool. The Doctor says his shipping records sit in the dispatch shack. If Hollis is alive, those records know where.

b6_2.t: Rosa built me a flamethrower out of a crop duster and a bad attitude. Tonight, we turn the lights out.

m6_rosa_01.t: That's the depot. Take out the radio mast first, before they call the whole Legion down on you.

m6_legion_01.t: Intruder at the fuel farm! Hit the alarm!

m6_rosa_02.t: Radio's down. Now the fuel tanks. Make it a bonfire.

m6_rosa_02b.t: They got a call out! Reinforcements coming from the gate. Hurry, Deacon!

m6_deacon_01.t: That ought to be visible from Vegas.

m6_rosa_03.t: Dispatch shack is the tin shed by the gate. Ram it, burn it, whatever. Just get me those papers.

m6_deacon_02.t: Got them. Transfer orders. One prisoner, moved to the Silver Queen mine. Name of Calloway, H.

m6_rusk_01.t: This is Colonel Rusk. Vale, your depot is on fire. You assured me this cowboy was handled.

m6_vale_01.t: Relax, Colonel. A man who fights this hard for his brother can be predicted. And what can be predicted can be arranged.

m6_rosa_05.t: More headlights on the Mercury road. Get out of there, Deacon! Head west!

b7_1.t: The Silver Queen mine played out in eighteen-ninety. Vale uses it for things he doesn't want found. Guard towers, a gate, and somewhere in those tunnels, my brother.

b7_2.t: Preacher's bringing the Glory Wagon. Rosa bolted boiler plate over every inch of Sally. I'm bringing everything else.

m7_preacher_01.t: Brother Calloway, the gate is yours. I'll keep the guards praying.

m7_deacon_01.t: Towers first. They've got the high ground.

m7_legion_01.t: Calloway's here! Get the prisoner down the hole!

m7_hollis_01.t: Wade? Wade, is that you out there? It's Hollis! They've got me in the loading shed!

m7_hollis_02.t: They kept my rig in here. Old Bessie's got half a tank. Clear me a road and I'll drive her out myself!

m7_vale_01.t: Mister Calloway. You've found your brother. How touching. I'm afraid I'll have to take him back.

m7_hollis_04.t: I knew you'd come. I told them, my brother's the meanest son of a gun on the West Coast.

m7_hollis_05.t: The Army's testing a bomb at dawn. Rusk is putting the real core on a convoy tonight, and Vale's men are gonna hit it on the Mercury road.

m7_miriam_01.t: Then they'll detonate a dummy at dawn, and nobody will know a real bomb is missing until it's far too late.

b8_1.t: Broken Arrow. That's what the Army calls it when they lose an atomic weapon.

b8_2.t: At sundown Vale's men hit the Commission convoy on the Mercury road. The core is locked inside an armored truck they call the Juggernaut, headed for Vale's airstrip at Indian Springs. If it gets there, it gets gone.

m8_rosa_01.t: There's the Juggernaut. Built like a bank vault on wheels. Rockets, Deacon. Lots of rockets.

m8_legion_01.t: Protect the Juggernaut! Box him out!

m8_miriam_01.t: Careful! Gunfire won't set the core off, but I'd rather not scatter plutonium across the whole county!

m8_rosa_02.t: It's past Frenchman Flat! You're running out of road!

m8_deacon_01.t: Juggernaut's down. Checking the vault. It's empty. Nothing but sandbags.

m8_vale_01.t: Did you truly believe I'd bet everything on one hand, Mister Calloway? The house never shows its cards.

m8_miriam_02.t: Then the real core is with Vale himself.

m8_hollis_01.t: His Cadillac. The Silver Duchess. He'll run for the airstrip at dawn, when every eye in Nevada is on that bomb.

m8_deacon_02.t: Then I'll be waiting at dawn.

b9_1.t: Dawn. In a few minutes the Army sets off an atom bomb on Yucca Flat, and every soldier and newsman in Nevada will be staring at the sky. Vale is counting on it.

b9_2.t: His Silver Duchess is running for Indian Springs with a stolen plutonium core in the trunk and the whole Chrome Legion around her. Rosa, Preacher, Hollis, even the Doctor. Everybody's on the radio. It's time to end this.

m9_control_01.t: This is Control. Shot Able, H minus three minutes. All personnel, goggles on, face away from ground zero.

m9_vale_01.t: Good morning, Mister Calloway. A beautiful day for the end of the world, isn't it?

m9_vale_02.t: In the new world, the man who owns the bomb owns the future. I intend to own it outright.

m9_preacher_01.t: Brother Calloway, I've got his outriders on the east flank. You go get that Cadillac!

m9_hollis_01.t: Bessie's parked across the south road! He'll have to go around the flat, Wade!

m9_rosa_01.t: Deacon, don't look at the flash!

m9_vale_03.t: Do you know what this car cost me? More than your whole miserable family!

m9_vale_04.t: You can't. The house always wins.

m9_deacon_03.t: Not today, Vale. Today the house went bust.

m9_miriam_01.t: The core casing held. It's intact, Deacon. It's over.

epi_1.t: The Army called it a training exercise. The papers called it a gas explosion. Colonel Rusk got himself reassigned to a weather station in Alaska.

epi_2.t: Miriam flew home to England with enough paper to bury half the Pentagon. Preacher got his stills back. Hollis and Rosa got married in the Gold Creek church, and Preacher did the honors.

epi_3.t: Me? I'm still out here. Somebody's got to ride shotgun on these roads. The atomic age has a speed limit. Nobody told us.

fail_dead.t: Deacon? Deacon, come in! Damn it.

fail_escort.t: We lost them, Deacon. It's over. Come on home.

fail_escape.t: They got away clean. We lost them.

bark_l_3.t: He's on my tail! Get him off me!

bark_l_4.t: Vale pays double for that Merc!

bark_r_1.t: Sally's hurting, Deacon! Find a repair kit!

bark_r_2.t: Your armor's paper thin! Get out of there!
